summary.zh: 文档站默认展示英文手册（Product Hunt 上架），侧边栏不再出现滚动条。
summary.en: The docs site now defaults to the English manual (for the Product Hunt launch), and the sidebar no longer shows a scrollbar.

highlights.zh: docs.modelswap.app 根路径默认打开英文手册，中文手册移至 /zh/，顶部可一键切换。
highlights.en: docs.modelswap.app now opens the English manual by default; the Chinese manual moved to /zh/ with a one-click toggle in the header.

highlights.zh: 手册侧边栏在矮视口下不再显示滚动条（保留滚动能力）。
highlights.en: The manual sidebar no longer shows a scrollbar on short viewports (scrolling still works).

highlights.zh: 文档站构建脚本与主站 SEO 产物（robots/sitemap/llms/IndexNow）对齐英文默认语言，站内互链与语言切换链接同步更新。
highlights.en: The docs build now aligns its SEO artifacts (robots/sitemap/llms/IndexNow) with the English default, keeping in-page language links consistent.
